description: This file contains implementation for network interface management on Windows, including retrieving network list, interface types, WLAN connection attributes, and Wi-Fi options.

classes.name: ScopedWifiOptions
classes.description: Base class for managing Wi-Fi options scope.

classes.name: WifiOptionSetter
classes.description: Implements setting Wi-Fi options such as disable scan and media streaming mode.

classes.name: WlanApi
classes.description: Handles dynamic loading and access to WLAN API functions on Windows.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceType
methods.description: Converts Windows interface type to internal network connection type.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves current WLAN connection attributes if available.

methods.name: GetNetworkListImpl
methods.description: Populates network list based on adapter info, filtering out loopback and virtual interfaces.

methods.name: GetNetworkList
methods.description: Retrieves list of network interfaces on Windows, handling buffer resizing.

methods.name: GetWifiPHYLayerProtocol
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi physical layer protocol based on connection attributes.

methods.name: SetWifiOptions
methods.description: Creates a scope object to set Wi-Fi options.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the current Wi-Fi connection.
